topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
response: Onboard memory constraints dictate that only packets with time tags (immediate services) can be stored. This limits immediate service prioritization to those requiring on-board storage, while pre-flight and post-flight operations for time-tagged services are handled differently.
reference_context: The provided text describes the satellite's on-board memory constraints (limited size - bs). The maximum data packet upload size is defined as bs. This constraint limits the amount of data that can be stored, impacting service prioritization.
